views.definition: WITH date_series AS ( SELECT (generate_series((( SELECT min(date(instance_audit.activated_at)) AS min FROM instance_audit WHERE (instance_audit.billed_to IS NOT NULL)))::timestamp with time zone, (CURRENT_DATE)::timestamp with time zone, '1 day'::interval))::date AS date ), instance_daily_costs AS ( SELECT day.date, audit.instance_id, audit.billed_to, audit.hourly_rate, CASE WHEN ((date(audit.activated_at) < day.date) AND (date(COALESCE((audit.stop_billing_at)::timestamp with time zone, now())) > day.date)) THEN 24.0 WHEN ((date(audit.activated_at) = day.date) AND (date(COALESCE((audit.stop_billing_at)::timestamp with time zone, now())) = day.date)) THEN (EXTRACT(epoch FROM (COALESCE((audit.stop_billing_at)::timestamp with time zone, now()) - audit.activated_at)) / 3600.0) WHEN (date(audit.activated_at) = day.date) THEN (EXTRACT(epoch FROM ((date_trunc('day'::text, audit.activated_at) + '1 day'::interval) - audit.activated_at)) / 3600.0) WHEN (date(COALESCE((audit.stop_billing_at)::timestamp with time zone, now())) = day.date) THEN (EXTRACT(epoch FROM (COALESCE((audit.stop_billing_at)::timestamp with time zone, now()) - date_trunc('day'::text, COALESCE((audit.stop_billing_at)::timestamp with time zone, now())))) / 3600.0) ELSE (0)::numeric END AS hours_on_day, CASE WHEN ((date(audit.activated_at) < day.date) AND (date(COALESCE((audit.stop_billing_at)::timestamp with time zone, now())) > day.date)) THEN ((24.0)::double precision * audit.hourly_rate) WHEN ((date(audit.activated_at) = day.date) AND (date(COALESCE((audit.stop_billing_at)::timestamp with time zone, now())) = day.date)) THEN (((EXTRACT(epoch FROM (COALESCE((audit.stop_billing_at)::timestamp with time zone, now()) - audit.activated_at)) / 3600.0))::double precision * audit.hourly_rate) WHEN ((date(audit.activated_at) = day.date) AND (date(COALESCE((audit.stop_billing_at)::timestamp with time zone, now())) > day.date)) THEN (((EXTRACT(epoch FROM ((date_trunc('day'::text, audit.activated_at) + '1 day'::interval) - audit.activated_at)) / 3600.0))::double precision * audit.hourly_rate) WHEN ((date(audit.activated_at) < day.date) AND (date(COALESCE((audit.stop_billing_at)::timestamp with time zone, now())) = day.date)) THEN (((EXTRACT(epoch FROM (COALESCE((audit.stop_billing_at)::timestamp with time zone, now()) - date_trunc('day'::text, COALESCE((audit.stop_billing_at)::timestamp with time zone, now())))) / 3600.0))::double precision * audit.hourly_rate) ELSE (0)::double precision END AS daily_revenue FROM (date_series day CROSS JOIN instance_audit audit) WHERE ((audit.billed_to IS NOT NULL) AND (audit.deleted_at IS NULL) AND (audit.activated_at IS NOT NULL) AND (day.date >= date(audit.activated_at)) AND (day.date <= date(COALESCE((audit.stop_billing_at)::timestamp with time zone, now())))) ) SELECT instance_daily_costs.date, count(DISTINCT instance_daily_costs.instance_id) AS active_instance_count, sum(instance_daily_costs.hours_on_day) AS total_instance_hours, sum(instance_daily_costs.daily_revenue) AS instance_revenue FROM instance_daily_costs WHERE (instance_daily_costs.daily_revenue > (0)::double precision) GROUP BY instance_daily_costs.date ORDER BY instance_daily_costs.date DESC;
views.name: daily_instance_revenue

views.comment: Compatibility cache only: current paid invocation-quota activations; not authoritative historical subscription revenue.
views.definition: SELECT COALESCE(subscription.date, paygo.date, instance.date, sponsored.date) AS date, COALESCE(subscription.new_subscriber_count, (0)::bigint) AS new_subscriber_count, COALESCE(subscription.new_subscriber_revenue, (0)::bigint) AS new_subscriber_revenue, COALESCE(paygo.paygo_revenue, (0)::double precision) AS paygo_revenue, COALESCE(instance.instance_revenue, (0)::double precision) AS instance_revenue, COALESCE(sponsored.sponsored_inference, (0)::double precision) AS sponsored_inference FROM (((( SELECT date(COALESCE(invocation_quotas.effective_date, invocation_quotas.updated_at)) AS date, count(*) AS new_subscriber_count, sum( CASE WHEN (invocation_quotas.quota = ANY (ARRAY[(300)::bigint, (301)::bigint])) THEN 3 WHEN (invocation_quotas.quota = ANY (ARRAY[(2000)::bigint, (2001)::bigint])) THEN 10 WHEN (invocation_quotas.quota = ANY (ARRAY[(5000)::bigint, (5001)::bigint])) THEN 20 ELSE 0 END) AS new_subscriber_revenue FROM invocation_quotas WHERE (((invocation_quotas.chute_id)::text = '*'::text) AND (invocation_quotas.quota = ANY (ARRAY[(300)::bigint, (301)::bigint, (2000)::bigint, (2001)::bigint, (5000)::bigint, (5001)::bigint]))) GROUP BY (date(COALESCE(invocation_quotas.effective_date, invocation_quotas.updated_at)))) subscription FULL JOIN ( SELECT date(usage_data.bucket) AS date, sum(usage_data.amount) AS paygo_revenue FROM usage_data WHERE ((usage_data.user_id)::text <> '5682c3e0-3635-58f7-b7f5-694962450dfc'::text) GROUP BY (date(usage_data.bucket))) paygo ON ((subscription.date = paygo.date))) FULL JOIN ( SELECT daily_instance_revenue.date, daily_instance_revenue.instance_revenue FROM daily_instance_revenue) instance ON ((COALESCE(subscription.date, paygo.date) = instance.date))) FULL JOIN ( SELECT date(usage.bucket) AS date, (sum(usage.amount) - max(sponsorship.daily_threshold)) AS sponsored_inference FROM ((usage_data usage JOIN inference_sponsorships sponsorship ON ((((usage.user_id)::text = sponsorship.user_id) AND (date(usage.bucket) >= sponsorship.start_date) AND ((sponsorship.end_date IS NULL) OR (date(usage.bucket) <= sponsorship.end_date))))) JOIN sponsorship_chutes chute ON (((chute.sponsorship_id = sponsorship.id) AND (chute.chute_id = (usage.chute_id)::text)))) GROUP BY (date(usage.bucket))) sponsored ON ((COALESCE(subscription.date, paygo.date, instance.date) = sponsored.date))) ORDER BY COALESCE(subscription.date, paygo.date, instance.date, sponsored.date) DESC;
views.name: daily_revenue_summary

views.definition: SELECT users.user_id, users.balance AS stored_balance, COALESCE(sum( CASE WHEN ((instances.activated_at IS NOT NULL) AND (instances.stop_billing_at > now()) AND ((users.permissions_bitmask & (16)::bigint) <> 16)) THEN (((EXTRACT(epoch FROM (LEAST(COALESCE((instances.stop_billing_at)::timestamp with time zone, now()), now()) - instances.activated_at)) / 3600.0))::double precision * instances.hourly_rate) ELSE (0)::double precision END), (0)::double precision) AS total_instance_costs, (users.balance - COALESCE(sum( CASE WHEN ((instances.activated_at IS NOT NULL) AND (instances.stop_billing_at > now()) AND ((users.permissions_bitmask & (16)::bigint) <> 16)) THEN (((EXTRACT(epoch FROM (LEAST(COALESCE((instances.stop_billing_at)::timestamp with time zone, now()), now()) - instances.activated_at)) / 3600.0))::double precision * instances.hourly_rate) ELSE (0)::double precision END), (0)::double precision)) AS effective_balance FROM (users LEFT JOIN instances ON (((instances.billed_to)::text = (users.user_id)::text))) GROUP BY users.user_id, users.balance, users.permissions_bitmask;
views.name: user_current_balance
